signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.wrong: The user name or the password is not correct.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little, and try again.
signIn.cookieNotKeptTitle: Your browser did not keep the session
signIn.cookieNotKept: The name and password were right, but the session cookie was not kept. It is marked Secure, and this address is plain HTTP on a host that is not localhost. Use HTTPS, or ask the administrator to set MEGOOARTI_SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=false.

password.title: Change password
password.mustChange: Your password was set for you. Choose your own before going on.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
password.notTheSame: The two new passwords are not the same.
password.notDifferent: The new password must be different from the current one.

home.title: Repositories
home.empty: There is no repository you can browse. An administrator creates repositories and says who may use them.

errors.network_error: The server could not be reached. Check the connection, and try again.
errors.unexpected_answer: The server answered in a way this page does not understand.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.unauthorized: You are not signed in, or your session has ended.
errors.internal_error: The server met a fault. It has been logged.

notFound.title: There is nothing at this address
notFound.body: The page may have moved, or the address may be mistyped.

crash.title: This page stopped working
crash.body: Something in the page itself failed. Loading it again usually helps.

browse.kindProxy: {format} repository, {type}. What is here is what has been fetched through it.
browse.offline: This repository is offline: package clients are refused. It can still be browsed here.
browse.emptyProxy: Nothing has been fetched through this proxy yet. What it holds is what was asked of it.
browse.noFolder: There is nothing at {folder} in this repository.
browse.membersIntro: A group holds nothing of its own. It answers from these repositories, in this order. Those you may not browse are not listed.
browse.deleteFileBody: The file is removed as its format's own client would remove it. It cannot be brought back.
browse.deleteFolderBody: Every file under {folder} is deleted. It cannot be brought back.
browse.deletedSoFar: {deleted, plural, one {# file deleted so far} other {# files deleted so far}}…
browse.folderDeleted: Deleted {deleted, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} under {name}.{skipped, plural, =0 {} one { # file is kept by the format.} other { # files are kept by the format.}}
browse.folderStopped: Stopped. {deleted, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} under {name} had been deleted.

component.noUsage: A file of this kind has no command to copy. Its files have their own addresses.
component.deleteBody: {count, plural, one {Its file is} other {Its # files are}} deleted, as the format's own client would delete the version. It cannot be brought back.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Components in every repository you can browse.

hints.q: Each word must be in the name, the group, the version or the description. * stands for anything.
hints.checksum: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512: its length says which.

search.notAChecksum: A checksum is 32, 40, 64 or 128 hexadecimal digits.
search.found: {total, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} found.
search.none: No component you can browse matches. Try fewer words, or * for part of a name.

upload.title: Upload
upload.chooserIntro: The repositories you can upload to.
upload.nowhere: There is no hosted repository you may add to. A proxy and a group take no upload, and a Docker image is pushed with a container client.

intro.raw: Files, stored under a directory by their own names.
intro.maven: An artifact, stored where its coordinates say. Checksums and metadata follow by themselves.
intro.npm: A package tarball, as npm pack writes it. Its package.json says what it is.
intro.pypi: Wheels and source distributions. Each one's name says its project and version.

fields.generatePom: Write a POM if the version has none

hints.directory: Where in the repository the files go. Empty is its root.
hints.packaging: What the POM that is written says: jar, war, pom.
hints.pom: Optional. Whatever it is called, it is stored as the version's POM.
hints.generatePom: A build that depends on an artifact without a POM warns, or fails.
hints.classifier: What sets this file apart: sources, javadoc.
hints.requiresPython: For example >=3.9. Installers then offer the files only to such a Python.

files.maven: The file's own name does not matter. What it is (jar, war) is read from its end.

upload.stored: {count, plural, one {# file stored} other {# files stored}}
upload.storedNotice: Stored {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in {repository}.
upload.notHosted: Only a hosted repository takes an upload. A proxy holds what its remote has, and a group holds nothing of its own.
upload.notDocker: An image is pushed with a container client, not uploaded.
upload.notAllowed: You do not have permission to add to this repository.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: How this UI behaves for you. They are kept in this browser, and take effect as you choose them.
preferences.searchKey: Go to the search box with the / key
preferences.searchKeyHint: From anywhere that is not a place to type. Turn it off if the key gets in your way, as it can when you dictate.

permissions.notAPattern: A pattern is words joined by a colon, with * for any one word: repository:maven:*:read.

grants.all: Everything: every repository, and all of the administration.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: A token signs in for you where a password should not be: in a build, a script, a package client's settings.

hints.name: What it is for: you will know it by this name.

limitHints.everything: It can do what you can in the repositories and the administration, now and as your roles change. It cannot make tokens or change your password.
limitHints.read: Browse and download from the repositories you may read. Nothing else.
limitHints.custom: Whatever you choose here, it never does more than you may do yourself.

tokens.customNeeded: Add at least one permission, or choose another limit.
tokens.madeOnce: This is the only time it is shown. Copy it now: it cannot be shown again, only replaced.
tokens.madeUse: Use it as a bearer token, or as the password with your user name (or the name __token__) where a client asks for one.
tokens.revokeBody: Whatever uses it is refused from then on. It cannot be brought back, only replaced by a new one.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Who can sign in, and what roles they hold.

fields.mustChange: Must choose a new password at the next sign-in

hints.username: Letters, digits and . _ @ - , up to 64. It cannot be changed later.
hints.password: At least {min} characters. Type one, or have one made.
hints.newPassword: At least {min} characters. Their sessions end when it is set.
hints.mustChange: They sign in with this one once, and then choose their own.
hints.disabled: Cannot sign in, and their tokens are refused. Nothing of theirs is deleted.

users.usernameRule: A user name is 1 to 64 letters, digits or . _ @ -
users.emailRule: This is not an email address.
users.passwordRule: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
users.noRoles: There is no role to give.
users.rolesNotReadable: You may not see the roles, so none can be given here.
users.createdMustChange: Pass this password on to them. They sign in with it once, and then choose their own.
users.createdKeeps: Pass this password on to them. It stays their password until they change it.
users.createdOnce: It is not shown again once you leave this page.
users.builtinNote: This user is built in. It can be changed, and not deleted.
users.selfState: This is your own account: you cannot disable it.
users.passwordSetOnce: Pass it on to them. It is not shown again once you leave this page.
users.deleteIntro: Their tokens and sessions go with them. What they stored stays.
users.deleteBody: They can no longer sign in, and every token of theirs is refused. This cannot be undone.
users.selfDelete: This is your own account: you cannot delete it.
users.builtinDelete: A built-in user cannot be deleted. It can be disabled.
users.selfPassword: This is your own account: your password is changed under your account, where you are asked for the one you have.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: What a user may do is what their roles grant.

hints.name: Letters, digits and . _ - , up to 64. It cannot be changed later.

roles.nameRule: A role's name is 1 to 64 letters, digits or . _ -
roles.noPermissions: It grants nothing of its own.
roles.adminFixed: This is the role that makes an administrator. It grants everything, and cannot be changed.
roles.builtinNote: This role is built in. It can be changed, and not deleted.
roles.deleteIntro: Users who hold it, and roles that contain it, lose what it grants.
roles.deleteBody: Everyone who holds it loses what it grants, at once. This cannot be undone.
roles.nameDots: A role cannot be called . or .. : its page would have no address.

anonymous.title: Anonymous access
anonymous.intro: Whether someone who is not signed in may use this server at all.
anonymous.onMeans: Anyone who can reach this server may do what is listed below, without signing in.
anonymous.offMeans: Nothing is given without signing in. Package clients need credentials.
anonymous.askBody: Anyone who can reach this server will then be able to do what the anonymous user may do, without signing in. Look at what that is before you go on.
anonymous.notReadable: You may not see users and roles, so what a visitor may do cannot be shown here.
anonymous.userNotFound: The anonymous user was not found among the first users.
anonymous.toUsers: Look for it among the users
anonymous.rolesIntro: A visitor acts as the built-in user anonymous, with the roles it holds.
anonymous.grantsNothing: Its roles grant nothing in any repository.
anonymous.onlyRepositories: Whatever its roles say, a visitor is never allowed anything but what concerns repositories.
anonymous.userDisabled: The anonymous user is disabled, so nothing is given without signing in, though the switch is on. Enable the user to let visitors in.

members.none: It has no member yet, and so answers nothing.
members.nothingToAdd: There is no other repository of this format to add.

manage.title: Manage repositories
manage.intro: Every repository as it is set up. To use one, browse it.
manage.newIntro: The format and the type decide what else there is to set. Neither can be changed later.
manage.settingsOf: How this repository is set up.
manage.empty: A repository is where packages are stored, fetched through, or presented from.

fields.name: Name
fields.authType: Signs in to the remote with
fields.negativeCache: Remember what the remote does not have
fields.autoBlock: Leave the remote alone after it fails
fields.blocked: Blocked: do not contact the remote at all
fields.members: Members, in the order they are asked

hints.name: Letters, digits and . _ - , up to 64. It is part of every address, and cannot be changed later.
hints.online: Offline, package clients are refused. It can still be browsed and set up here.
hints.blobStore: Where its files are kept. It cannot be changed later.
hints.blobStoreUnreadable: You may not see the blob stores, so the default one is used.
hints.policyFollows: Until you choose one, this follows the format and the version policy.
hints.remoteUrl: An http or https address, without a user name, a password, a query or a fragment.
hints.secret: It is sealed before it is stored, and shown to nobody again.
hints.secretStored: One is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or type another to replace it.
hints.maxAge: After that it is checked with the remote again. 0 checks every time, -1 never again.
hints.metadataMaxAge: Indexes and listings: what says which versions there are. 0 checks every time, -1 never again.
hints.negativeCache: A path the remote did not have is not asked for again for a while.
hints.autoBlock: A minute at first, doubling with each further failure up to an hour. Meanwhile what is cached is served.
hints.blocked: Only what is cached is served, until this is unticked.
hints.members: The first that has what is asked for answers. Offline members, and proxies whose remote is unavailable, are passed over.
hints.suite: The name a machine gives it in its sources line, such as trixie or stable. It cannot be changed later.
hints.repodataDepth: How many directories down repodata/ is: 0 at the top, 1 for one in each directory of the top (el9/repodata/), up to {most}. Packages are kept at least that deep. It cannot be changed later.

remoteKeys.apt: ASCII-armoured OpenPGP keys, those the remote signs its Release files with. A group checks what this proxy fetched with them: without them, it cannot be a member of one.
remoteKeys.yum: ASCII-armoured OpenPGP keys, those the remote signs its repomd.xml with, if it does. A group checks what this proxy fetched with them. They are not needed: dnf checks each package's own signature.
remoteKeys.apk: PEM RSA public keys, those the remote signs its indexes with: Alpine's are in /usr/share/apk/keys. A group checks what this proxy fetched with them: without them, it cannot be a member of one.

typesHints.hosted: Stores what is uploaded or deployed to it.
typesHints.proxy: Fetches from a remote repository, and keeps what it fetched.
typesHints.group: Presents several repositories at one address. It stores nothing of its own.

policiesHints.allow_redeploy: A version that is there can be stored again, replacing it.
policiesHints.disable_redeploy: A version that is there is refused. What is new is taken.
policiesHints.read_only: Nothing is taken and nothing is deleted.

auth.basic: A user name and a password

versionsHints.release: Only versions that are not snapshots.

layoutsHints.strict: Only paths that are laid out as Maven lays them out.

problems.nameRule: A repository's name is 1 to 64 letters, digits or . _ -
problems.nameDots: A repository cannot be called . or .. : it would have no address.
problems.dockerNameRule: A Docker repository's name is the first part of its images' names: lower-case letters and digits, with single . _ __ or - between them.
problems.remoteRule: Give an http or https address with a host, and without credentials, a query or a fragment.
problems.ageRule: A whole number of minutes, -1 or more.
problems.ttlRule: A whole number of minutes, 1 or more.
problems.suiteRule: A suite is 1 to 64 letters, digits or . _ - , and begins with a letter or a digit.

manage.checkAgainIntro: What was cached is served without asking the remote until its time is up. This makes all of it be checked again at its next use.
manage.checkedAgain: {name} will check everything with its remote again.
manage.rebuildIntro: Goes through every file again: which component it belongs to, and the words it is found by. It repairs what an older version stored differently, and can take a while.
manage.rebuiltFound: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} looked at, {moved} given to another component. {components, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} looked at, {removed} removed for having no file left.
manage.deleteIntro: Everything stored in it is deleted with it.
manage.deleteIntroGroup: Its members stay as they are: a group stores nothing of its own.
manage.deleteBody: Every component and file in it is deleted, and every client that uses its address is refused. This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteBodyGroup: Every client that uses its address is refused. Its members are not touched. This cannot be undone.

blobStores.title: Blob stores
blobStores.intro: Where the files of the repositories are kept.

hints.name: Letters, digits and . _ - , up to 64.
hints.directory: Optional. Under the data directory unless it starts at the root. Without one, the store's name is used.

blobStores.nameRule: A blob store's name is 1 to 64 letters, digits or . _ -
blobStores.nameDots: A blob store cannot be called . or .. : its directory would not be its own.
blobStores.deleteBody: The server forgets the store. Its files stay on the disk, for you to remove. A store that a repository uses is not deleted.

system.title: System
system.intro: What is running here, and the address it gives out as its own.

fields.baseUrl: The address of this server, as its clients reach it

hints.baseUrl: Used in every address the server gives out. Leave it empty to use the address each request came to. Set it when the server is behind a proxy that does not pass the address on.

system.baseUrlRule: Give an http or https address, without a user name, a password, a query or a fragment.

signing.title: Signing key
signing.intro: Its indexes are signed with this key. A machine that uses the repository installs the public key, and trusts what the key signed.
signing.replaceIntro: Every machine that uses the repository must then install the new public key, or it refuses what the repository serves.

privateKeyHints.openpgp: ASCII-armoured OpenPGP that can sign, without a passphrase. It is sealed before it is stored, and shown to nobody.
privateKeyHints.rsa: PEM RSA, without a passphrase. It is sealed before it is stored, and shown to nobody.

signing.replaceBody: Its indexes are signed with that key from now on. Every machine that uses {name} must install the new public key, or it refuses what the repository serves.
